result.topic_en: Gauss expands cos(2x cos φ) and sin(2x cos φ) as cosine series in multiples of φ, giving power series for the coefficients (Bessel-type functions) and recurrences among them, then notes that an asymptotic series e^{2x}(x^{-1/2}+...) satisfies the same differential equation as y = 1 + x^2 + x^4/4 + ...
result.transcription:
Es sei $\cos(2x\cos\varphi) = A + 2C\cos 2\varphi + 2E\cos 4\varphi + 2G\cos 6\varphi + \ldots$
$\sin(2x\cos\varphi) = 2B\cos\varphi + 2D\cos 3\varphi + 2F\cos 5\varphi + \ldots$

$A = 1 - xx + \frac{1}{4}x^4 - \frac{1}{36}x^6 + \frac{1}{576}x^8 - \frac{1}{14400}x^{10} +$
$C = -\frac{1}{2}xx + \frac{1}{6}x^4 - \frac{1}{48}x^6 + \frac{1}{720}x^8 - \frac{1}{17280}x^{10} +$
$E = +\frac{1}{24}x^4 - \frac{1}{120}x^6 + \frac{1}{1440}x^8 - \frac{1}{30240}x^{10} +$
$G = -\frac{1}{720}x^6 + \frac{1}{5040}x^8 - \frac{1}{80640}x^{10} +$

$B = x - \frac{1}{2}x^3 + \frac{1}{12}x^5 - \frac{1}{144}x^7 + \frac{1}{2880}x^9 - \frac{1}{86400}x^{11} +$
$D = -\frac{1}{6}x^3 + \frac{1}{24}x^5 - \frac{1}{240}x^7 + \frac{1}{4320}x^9 - \frac{1}{120960}x^{11} +$
$F = +\frac{1}{120}x^5 - \frac{1}{720}x^7 + \frac{1}{10080}x^9 - \frac{1}{241920}x^{11} +$

$A - \frac{B}{x} - C = 0$
$B + \frac{2C}{x} - D = 0$
$C - \frac{3D}{x} - E = 0$
$D + \frac{4E}{x} - F = 0$
$E - \frac{5F}{x} + G = 0$ etc.

Dieselbe Differentialgleichung welche die Function
$y = 1 + xx + \frac{1}{4}x^4 + \frac{1}{36}x^6 + \frac{1}{576}x^8$ u. s. w.
bestimmt, nemlich
$\frac{d\frac{x\,dy}{dx}}{dx} = 4xy$
thut auch Genüge
$y = e^{2x}\left(x^{-\frac12} + \frac{1}{16}x^{-\frac32} + \frac{1}{16}\cdot\frac{9}{32}\cdot x^{-\frac52} + \frac{1\cdot9\cdot25}{16\cdot32\cdot48}x^{-\frac72}\ldots\right)$
Es wird nemlich
$\frac{x\,dy}{dx} = 2e^{2x}\left(x^{\frac12} - \frac{3}{16}x^{-\frac12} - \frac{3\cdot5}{16\cdot32}x^{-\frac32} - \frac{3\cdot5\cdot21}{16\cdot32\cdot48}x^{-\frac52} - \frac{3\cdot5\cdot21\cdot45}{16\cdot32\cdot48\cdot64}x^{-\frac72}\ldots\right)$

[margin, right edge:] $y = e^{2x}($

methods.what: Fourier cosine expansion of cos(2x cos φ) and sin(2x cos φ) in multiples of φ (Jacobi–Anger type expansion with Bessel-function coefficients)
Power series of the even-order coefficients (essentially ±J_{2n}(2x))
Power series of the odd-order coefficients (essentially ±J_{2n+1}(2x))
Three-term recurrence relations among successive coefficients (Bessel recurrence)
Differential equation satisfied by the series y = Σ x^{2n}/(n!)^2 (modified Bessel function I_0(2x))
Asymptotic series solution of the same differential equation of the form e^{2x} times a series in x^{-1/2}
Computation of x dy/dx for the asymptotic series to verify the differential equation

items.english: The same differential equation which determines the function y = 1 + x^2 + x^4/4 + x^6/36 + x^8/576 etc., namely d(x dy/dx)/dx = 4xy, is also satisfied by y = e^{2x}(x^{-1/2} + x^{-3/2}/16 + ...).
